classification: OWNER_APPROVED_ADAPTATION: every save carries its own fixed id, so the first-bind gift ledger can tell saves apart (its save reference used to be the constant session id shared by every save)

saveField.shape: "sv1-" + 32 lowercase hex digits (128 random bits from crypto.getRandomValues); any other value is refused as INVALID_SAVE_ID
saveField.lifecycle: made once per new game; an older save is given one in memory when opened (Continue stays read-only) and every later write carries it; ensureSaveReference writes it before a first-bind claim names it, and hands out nothing while a battle, a hunt or the tutorial owns the save or when the write fails
saveField.compatibility: lives in flags, where an older build drops an unknown entry instead of refusing the save; such a build would write the save back without it, and the next open gives it a new id
saveField.use: the online layer sends only sha256(saveId) as claim_bind_reward's p_save_ref; the id itself never leaves the device

authorization: Owner 2026-11-08, asked whether each save should get its own fixed id at the cost of a save format change that older builds or tabs would read without it: 「核准，要讓自己的存檔有固定ID」.
